verdict.rationale: Licensing terms for commercial or enterprise use are a fair question for an open-source inference engine, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers license type, commercial-use terms, or any paid or enterprise tier. The items cover only features, performance, installation and contribution. Absent evidence for an applicable axis yields none.

support.subject: As a power-user, I know whether commercial or enterprise use requires a paid license or subscription beyond the free community edition
